# Vbluetech

> Vbluetech builds AI voice receptionists, AI chat agents and custom websites for small businesses in the United States, with a focus on HVAC companies, dental practices, med spas and real estate agents.

## Services
- AI Voice Agents: an AI receptionist that answers calls 24/7, handles common questions, books appointments and routes urgent calls to the business's team.
- AI Chat Agents: a website chat assistant trained on the business that answers questions, qualifies leads and collects contact details.
- Custom Websites: fast, mobile-friendly websites that make it easy for customers to call, chat or book.

## Pages
- [Home](https://vbluetech.com/): overview of services, industries and how it works
